git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Handle Ctrl+D in yes/no prompt gracefully

The custom prompt_yes_no loop silently ignored Ctrl+D (byte 0x04
in raw mode), causing it to loop forever.  If the terminal was
actually closed, read_key() returned an IO error that propagated
without restoring the hidden cursor.

Extract the key-reading loop into prompt_yes_no_loop so the
caller can unconditionally call show_cursor() after it returns.
Detect the 0x04 character explicitly and return
BivvyError::Interrupted instead of spinning.
EOF
)"

Handle Ctrl+D in yes/no prompt gracefully

The custom prompt_yes_no loop silently ignored Ctrl+D (byte 0x04

actually closed, read_key() returned an IO error that propagated
without restoring the hidden cursor.

Extract the key-reading loop into prompt_yes_no_loop so the
caller can unconditionally call show_cursor() after it returns.
Detect the 0x04 character explicitly and return
BivvyError::Interrupted instead of spinning.
EOF
)"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Handle Ctrl+D in yes/no prompt gracefully

The custom prompt_yes_no loop silently ignored Ctrl+D (byte 0x04
in raw mode), causing it to loop forever.  If the terminal was
actually closed, read_key() returned an IO error that propagated
without restoring the hidden cursor.

Extract the key-reading loop into prompt_yes_no_loop so the
caller can unconditionally call show_cursor() after it returns.
Detect the 0x04 character explicitly and return
BivvyError::Interrupted instead of spinning.
EOF
)"

commit 955f02a8b73ea9e00c69a16b53a53c0c0a73e4a4
Author: benchmark <benchmark@localhost>
Date:   Mon Mar 16 20:15:34 2026 -0600

    Handle Ctrl+D in yes/no prompt gracefully
    
    The custom prompt_yes_no loop silently ignored Ctrl+D (byte 0x04
    in raw mode), causing it to loop forever.  If the terminal was
    actually closed, read_key() returned an IO error that propagated
    without restoring the hidden cursor.
    
    Extract the key-reading loop into prompt_yes_no_loop so the
    caller can unconditionally call show_cursor() after it returns.
    Detect the 0x04 character explicitly and return
    BivvyError::Interrupted instead of spinning.
